passage.text: My name is Lek, and I'm a chef at a hotel in Bangkok.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈneɪm ɪz ˈlɛk, ənd aɪm ə ˈʃɛf ət ə hoʊˈtɛl ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: I work from two in the afternoon until eleven at night.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈwɜːrk frəm ˈtuː ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn ənˈtɪl ɪˈlɛvən ət ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: I cook Thai food for the hotel guests.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈkʊk ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd fər ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈɡɛsts.

passage.text: I'm Joy, and I'm a nurse at a children's hospital.
passage.reading: aɪm ˈdʒɔɪ, ənd aɪm ə ˈnɜːrs ət ə ˈtʃɪldrənz ˈhɑːspɪtəl.

passage.text: My shift starts at seven in the morning, and it's a busy job.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈʃɪft ˈstɑːrts ət ˈsɛvən ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ənd ɪts ə ˈbɪzi ˈdʒɑːb.

passage.text: I take care of sick children, and I love my job.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈteɪk ˈkɛr əv ˈsɪk ˈtʃɪldrən, ənd aɪ ˈlʌv maɪ ˈdʒɑːb.

passage.text: I'm Max, and I'm a tour guide in Chiang Mai.
passage.reading: aɪm ˈmæks, ənd aɪm ə ˈtʊr ˌɡaɪd ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

passage.text: Every morning, I meet a group of tourists at their hotel.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, aɪ ˈmiːt ə ˈɡruːp əv ˈtʊrɪsts ət ðɛr hoʊˈtɛl.

passage.text: Then we go on a tour of the old temples.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn wiː ˈɡoʊ ɑːn ə ˈtʊr əv ði ˈoʊld ˈtɛmpəlz.

passage.text: I speak English and Chinese, so I can talk with tourists from many countries.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈspiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ənd ˌtʃaɪˈniːz, soʊ aɪ kən ˈtɔːk wɪð ˈtʊrɪsts frəm ˈmɛni ˈkʌntriz.
